Each listed App installation and secret change confirmed as intended or revoked
context: Owner-only: needs PyPI and GitHub UI access and judgement that an agent cannot supply. What the public record already shows (2026-10-23): all 26 PyPI files and 4 TestPyPI files of benchbox match CI-recorded hashes, GitHub release assets and independent rebuilds from each tag; no unexpected publication, deploy key, webhook, invitation or collaborator; only one role (Owner) on both PyPI projects. NOT visible to an agent: PyPI/TestPyPI security history (uploads, deleted files, API tokens, trusted-publisher edits) and the GitHub organisation audit log (plan does not expose it). To review: PyPI > benchbox > Security history, and the same on TestPyPI, from 2025-04-30 to now, especially 2026-08-28 03:14-12:22 UTC (two v0.4.0 publish attempts failed with invalid-publisher, the third succeeded); GitHub Apps installed since 2026-09 (benchbox-publication-controller 09-01, benchbox-oracle 10-05, benchbox-site-bridge 10-09, claude 10-17 with contents/workflows/actions/hooks write on all repositories); repository secrets created or updated since 2026-07 (names only: RULESET_DRIFT_TOKEN updated 08-17, TODO_DB_RO_AUTH_TOKEN 08-11, TODO_DB_URL and TODO_EXPORT_PR_TOKEN created 07-19, SITE_BRIDGE_APP_ID and SITE_BRIDGE_PRIVATE_KEY created 10-09, BENCHBOX_MACHINE_ID_SALT 10-15); why the v0.4.0 and v0.4.2 GitHub Releases were edited after their jobs ended. Since 2026-10-23 the pypi and test-pypi environments admit only selected refs (see pypi-environment-protection-20261023).
description:
BenchBox releases up to 0.4.2 were published with pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish releases older than the v1.14.3 fix for the compromised eMudhra emSign CAs (GHSA-5xjx-3w67-w9x9), and the maintainer's tools reached PyPI and GitHub through clients that trusted them. A public audit found every PyPI file reproducible from source and no unexpected publication, but it could not see owner-only records. The owner should review:

- PyPI and TestPyPI project security history for `benchbox` (uploads, deleted files, API tokens, trusted-publisher changes) from 2025-04-30 to now, especially 2026-08-28 03:14-12:22 UTC, when two v0.4.0 publish attempts failed with `invalid-publisher` and a third succeeded.
- GitHub App installations made since 2026-09 (benchbox-publication-controller, benchbox-oracle, benchbox-site-bridge, and the `claude` app, which can write contents, workflows, actions and repository hooks on all repositories) and repository secrets created or updated since 2026-07.
- Why the v0.4.0 and v0.4.2 GitHub Releases were edited shortly after their release jobs finished (asset digests are unchanged).

The organisation audit-log API is unavailable on the current plan, so this is a UI review.
